# VariantStoryBench

Public, dated benchmarks for VariantStory and VariantLake, under GPL (>= 2).
Compose DuckClinVarbitration, ducksemantics, DuckHTS and DuckVEP or vep-rs
instead of building another source-ingestion or policy framework.

## Specification first

Read the [whole-system specification][system] and [implementation specification][implementation].
This repository owns the [public-data plan](public-data-plan.md),
[temporal benchmark](temporal-benchmark.md) and [result contracts](benchmark-contract.md).

## Public data path

```text
public provider history + gene/disease/variant/date scope
  -> selected inputs + public later outcomes
  -> VariantStory analysis
  -> predictions, transitions, incremental/full comparisons, metrics
```

Start with [ReVUS](https://github.com/tamerh/ReVUS)-style VUS transitions.
Use existing XML-derived SCV, RCV and VCV history for disease-aware extensions.
Public labels are published but do not enter earlier prediction inputs.
No private cohort or invented study population is required.

The package already provides relation validators, scoring and developer fixtures.
Public cohort selection, the bundled VariantStory adapter and temporal execution remain implementation work.
Existing generated micro-cohorts are software tests only, not the study population.

## Install

```r
remotes::install_github("RGenomicsETL/VariantStoryBench")
```

Use R and SQL with small source/version configuration. Reuse upstream metadata.
No additional checksum or approval service is part of the design.
